So I3 should contain a formula counting "Apple" in the Fruits column. 

The formula should use the header title to find the column. A common approach: `=COUNTIF(INDEX(A1:D15,0,MATCH(I1,A1:D1,0)),I2)`.

But the "Value" (I2) and header (I1) cells are in the H/I section. The count needs to count "Apple" in column B.

Let me craft the formula. Given I1 = "Fruits" (header), I2 = "Apple" (value to count), I3 = COUNTIF result.

Formula: `=COUNTIF(INDEX($A$1:$D$15,0,MATCH(I1,$A$1:$D$1,0)),I2)`

Let me verify MATCH(I1,A1:D1,0). A1="Animals"=1, B1="Fruits"=2, C1="Bevarages"=3, D1="Colors"=4. So MATCH returns 2. INDEX(A1:D15,0,2) gives column B. COUNTIF(B2:B15, I2="Apple") = 3.

import openpyxl

def main():
    input_path = sys.argv[1]
    output_path = sys.argv[2]

    wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(input_path)
    ws = wb['Sheet1']

    # I1 = column header title ("Fruits"), I2 = value to count ("Apple")
    # Build a formula that counts instances of the value in I2 within the
    # column whose header title matches I1.
    formula = '=COUNTIF(INDEX($A$1:$D$15,0,MATCH(I1,$A$1:$D$1,0)),I2)'
    ws['I3'] = formula

    wb.save(output_path)
